subject.title: Pause blocked background Claude CLI auth probes

question: Should Claude background Auto refresh use this failure-triggered cooldown, enforce the existing onlyOnUserAction prompt policy before launching opaque Claude CLI subprocesses, or combine both layers?
rationale: Both approaches affect provider availability and user prompt-policy semantics, while the two open PRs overlap without a confirmed permanent contract.

options.title: Combine policy and backoff
options.body: Honor onlyOnUserAction before opaque background subprocesses and retain coalescing plus bounded cooldowns for configurations that explicitly permit background probing.

options.title: Land cooldown mitigation
options.body: Merge this PR after packaged-app proof, accepting that the first prompt and a later prompt after cooldown expiry can still occur.

options.title: Prefer policy gate
options.body: Pause this PR and evaluate https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2191 as the single comprehensive fix for both identified subprocess paths.

recommendation.title: Combine policy and backoff
recommendation.body: Honor onlyOnUserAction before opaque background subprocesses and retain coalescing plus bounded cooldowns for configurations that explicitly permit background probing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Claude auth-policy and provider-routing history makes this the strongest available owner for choosing the permanent contract.
